Type: large global print area rug
Use: anchoring a seating or bed area; living room, bedroom, dining room
Style: bohemian, contemporary, modern
Materials: flat cotton weave
Colors: ivory, black
Shape: rectangular, bold repeating diamond and zigzag tribal motif, arrow border at the ends, flat low texture, large
Feel: graphic, lively, casual
Goes with: dark wood floors, grey upholstery, woven baskets, black accents; bohemian or modern rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Black and Ivory Global Print Cotton Area Rug, 8 x 11 Foot
product.description: 100% Cotton Imported Add style to your room with this global-inspired statement piece. Eclectic details, warm tones, and hand-crafted softness adds depth and big personality to small, neutral spaces. Geo print area rug in neutral tones Hand-tufted with 100% cotton Durable, lightweight flat low pile height weave fits any indoor space Pair with a rug pad (sold separately) 8' x 11' Ships tightly rolled in a protective bag Unroll, allow a few days for natural fibers to settle
